method: Each requested PNG opened individually with view_image at original detail. No phone or repository operations.
observations: The early owner share capture shows an empty timetable with zero responses behind a manually opened sheet. The complete App-friends, web-share and copy options remain available.

The saved-information/private-draft capture shows both 09:00 and 09:30 first-day cells checked, zero published responses, one hour unsubmitted, and complete Submit and share plus Choose final time actions. Title, location, date metadata and footer do not overlap.
After contact delivery, the owner's two selected cells remain green with count one and a submitted-one-hour footer. The redundant submit button is absent; choose-final-time remains visible.

The participant submission capture shows the same two cells with count two, two respondents in the header, a submitted-one-hour footer and the instruction to wait for the organizer's invitation. No share sheet is open.

Collecting and final-selection states show the small gray dot and plain collecting-availability text plus complete Europe/Berlin beneath the date range. The old collecting capsule is absent from the title/location area.

Final evening selection shows amber 23:00 and 23:30 cells, a first-date-to-next-date 23:00-00:00 one-hour summary, separate clear action and complete roster-next CTA. Its amber mode explanation is distinct from the gray collecting metadata.

The invitation capture shows first-day 23:00-24:00 and next-day 00:00-01:00 green invitation segments, the pending-confirmation header badge, response progress and complete confirm/decline actions. There is no contradictory time range.

The inviting-owner share capture retains the pending-formal-issuance badge and App-friends option. The confirmed-participant share capture instead shows the confirmed badge and only web-share/copy. Both sheet summaries display the full cross-midnight range and complete Done/title/action labels.
outcome: No new visible text truncation, in-app control overlap or inconsistent selected/invited time range was found within these eight ordinary Chinese light-mode captures.
limits: This part does not contain the actual create-to-timetable transition, first-submit opening the share sheet, contact-picker/chat-card screen, acceptance/publish tap itself, or either Calendar screen. Their execution cannot be claimed as visually reviewed from this subset.
Exact Calendar endpoints, occurrence uniqueness, both accounts' server records and the eight API checkpoints require the separate API evidence; they are not inferred from these images.
System AssistiveTouch overlays small portions of the rightmost grid or response-list entry in some captures and is separate from App layout.
The parent reported the same-package 368.720-second full native pass and eight successful API stages. This reviewer did not rerun or independently query those stages.
